auth_tokens_target.name: auth_tokens_target
auth_tokens_target.value:
("auth_tokens"."purpose" = 'teacher_invitation') = ("auth_tokens"."invitation_id" is not null and "auth_tokens"."user_id" is null)
        and ("auth_tokens"."user_id" is not null or "auth_tokens"."invitation_id" is not null)

ai_proposals_levels_range.name: ai_proposals_levels_range
ai_proposals_levels_range.value: "ai_proposals"."level_task" between 0 and 4 and "ai_proposals"."level_organization" between 0 and 4 and "ai_proposals"."level_vocabulary" between 0 and 4 and "ai_proposals"."level_grammar" between 0 and 4 and "ai_proposals"."level_mechanics" between 0 and 4

evaluation_runs_proposed.name: evaluation_runs_proposed
evaluation_runs_proposed.value: "evaluation_runs"."outcome" <> 'proposed' or ("evaluation_runs"."model_requested" is not null and "evaluation_runs"."attempts" >= 1 and cardinality("evaluation_runs"."attempt_errors") = "evaluation_runs"."attempts" - 1)

submissions_validated_started.name: submissions_validated_started
submissions_validated_started.value: "submissions"."status" not in ('validated', 'published') or "submissions"."teacher_started_at" is not null

teacher_evaluations_levels_range.name: teacher_evaluations_levels_range
teacher_evaluations_levels_range.value: ("teacher_evaluations"."level_task" is null or "teacher_evaluations"."level_task" between 0 and 4) and ("teacher_evaluations"."level_organization" is null or "teacher_evaluations"."level_organization" between 0 and 4) and ("teacher_evaluations"."level_vocabulary" is null or "teacher_evaluations"."level_vocabulary" between 0 and 4) and ("teacher_evaluations"."level_grammar" is null or "teacher_evaluations"."level_grammar" between 0 and 4) and ("teacher_evaluations"."level_mechanics" is null or "teacher_evaluations"."level_mechanics" between 0 and 4)

teacher_evaluations_proposal_levels.name: teacher_evaluations_proposal_levels
teacher_evaluations_proposal_levels.value: "teacher_evaluations"."origin" <> 'proposal' or ("teacher_evaluations"."level_task" is not null and "teacher_evaluations"."level_organization" is not null and "teacher_evaluations"."level_vocabulary" is not null and "teacher_evaluations"."level_grammar" is not null and "teacher_evaluations"."level_mechanics" is not null)

reading_runs_draft_student.name: reading_runs_draft_student
reading_runs_draft_student.value: "reading_runs"."draft_id" is null or "reading_runs"."student_id" is not null

submission_pages_read.name: submission_pages_read
submission_pages_read.value: ("submission_pages"."reading_status" = 'read') = ("submission_pages"."reading_text" is not null and "submission_pages"."has_writing" is not null and "submission_pages"."reading_run_id" is not null and "submission_pages"."read_at" is not null)
